original.indicated: only scripts/todo_sync.py, todo_sync/locking.py and the planned CLI test change

issue.why_categorical: the lock file inside the project is visible to the retire/split reference scan
issue.why_free_form: lease acquire --owner stores free text in <state_dir>/locks/<catalog>.lock; retire.other_references (git grep --untracked) skips history_paths but not state_dir, so an owner naming an item id made that item's own retire report the lock file as a reference to fix by hand

new_outcome.indicated: TASK-5 also adds state_dir to the skip list of retire.other_references and adds tests/scripts/test_todo_sync_lock_reference_scan.py, a git-backed test that a lease owner naming the retired id yields no locks/ reference line

why_new_outcome.free_form: without the skip a todo-editor retire under a lease can be told to hand-edit the lock body; the planned CLI tests run without git and cannot see it

original.location: TASK-6 action, triggers (b) and (c); TASK-6 files
original.indicated: an async_launched todo-editor result records its agentId and only that agent's turn.complete starts a drain; a task-notification prompt waits for a drain up to DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS; the task touches config.ts, inbox.ts, checks.ts, register.ts, their tests and the mirror test

issue.why_categorical: the built drain trigger and wait differ from TASK-6 and spec Decided 17
issue.why_free_form: checks.ts records no agentId: any subagent turn.complete drains whenever the inbox lists a queued *.json (drainQueued), and every hook wait is capped by waitCapMs (the hook budget less a margin, at most DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS) rather than DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS alone; band.test.tsx and summary.test.ts changed with the task though its receipt lists no extra files

new_outcome.indicated: TASK-6 drains at any subagent turn end when the inbox lists a queued file, caps each drain wait with waitCapMs(remainingMs), and adapts band.test.tsx and summary.test.ts to the new inbox context lines; the frozen spec stays as written

why_new_outcome.free_form: a queued file in the inbox is the drain condition for a foreground, a backgrounded and a left-over item alike, so no agentId bookkeeping is needed; a wait past the hook budget would let the engine give up on the hook before the summary attaches

issue.why_categorical: a hung gh call holds the catalog lease
issue.why_free_form: add --spec --file-issue runs gh issue create while holding the catalog write lock, so a hung gh (stalled network, auth prompt) kept every other writer, the todo-watch inbox drain among them, waiting with no bound (issue 161)

new_outcome.indicated: gh.py times out each gh call after GH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (120 s) and raises TodoSyncError; a test covers the timeout (commits 41d3ec0, 7168893), outside every TASK

why_new_outcome.free_form: a bounded gh call fails and releases the lock instead of blocking the serialized writers
